posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I am starting a podcast about RPG maker.
Here is the catch... I have AI generate the whole thing! I ask the AI to do a find as much information as possible about a subject, and then generate a podcast for me.
This podcast has 2(!) AI hosts, talking about whatever I want them to talk about.
For the first episode, I ask them to find info about JohnDoeNews as a game developer, but I didn't tell them that I am that game developer. Just to see what they come up with. I play my own game BiteMe!StoryMode during the podcast.
I plan to make an episode a week, every Saturday, but this week, because it is the first week, I made an extra episode, about the RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam. I play Project Kaww, one of the entries, while we listen to the podcast.
Here are episode 1 and 2.
I have an episode about my main game ready, and an episode about my Clock And Calendar plugin, but I do not only want to make episodes about my own stuff... So I'll save those for later.
I can do an episode about you and/or your game if you want. But to do this, you have to be active online. There has to be much to find about your work. This means updates you've posted over time, but also the replies you get. Believe me, when I made the episodes about my own game, they were not always positive and even mentioned alternatives by other forum members. Like in the episode about my plugin, they others by name, who made similar things. It also mentiond OrangeHud to show the clock on screen.
So, if you want me to do an episode about you and/or your game, you need to:
have online history. Your message count on this forum should be high.
understand that the AI is objective. It has no personal opinion.
be okay with negative feedback. The feedback is generated by what it finds online, searching 100's of websites, if you are that active, or if lost of people talk about you and/your game.
have a detailed game topic on this forum, if you want your game to be the subject, but any mention by anyone, anywhere, can be found and used by the AI.
Let me know what you guys think of the podcast, and feel free to message me when you want your project, or you as a developer, be the subject of the next podcast.
